# Capital Allocation Advisor

⚠️ **Finance warning / Avertissement finance** : informational only, not investment advice. A ranking framework orders choices, it does not make them safe: projects can miss their projected returns, buybacks above intrinsic value destroy value, and there is a real risk of loss in any deployment of capital, with no promise of return on any use ranked here. Curated by Skill Harbor: the capital allocation advisor skill at the root of andreworia/claude-finance-skills. Use it when a CFO or board must decide how to deploy available capital across competing uses: an annual capital plan, a windfall or asset sale that frees up cash, or a buyback versus dividend versus debt paydown debate. It is allocation across the whole capital base, not the standalone valuation of one acquisition target. The method sizes the allocable pool first (only surplus capital counts: beginning cash plus projected free cash flow, minus the minimum operating cash floor and committed outflows, over a stated 12 to 24 month horizon), sets one common hurdle by estimating WACC from market value weights, then estimates the marginal return on each use on a like for like basis: project ROIC for reinvestment, post-synergy ROIC with an execution haircut for M&A, the after-tax interest rate retired for debt paydown, the earnings or free cash flow yield for a buyback (with the explicit warning that buying back above intrinsic value destroys value whatever the optical EPS accretion), payout and signaling value for a...
